review.method: Coding-agent manual review against A2, published scene facts, and the shared mechanics contract. Expected states were authored before comparison runs; no engine invocation produced expected outcomes.
review.limitations: Development regression suite; not held out. Complexity annotations are coarse design labels, not measured graph statistics. Narrative wording requires separate blinded review.
